translations.EN: Cold wind today, but seeing your face makes it feel a bit warmer.
translations.TL: Malamig ang hangin, pero nakakabawas ng ginaw na makita ka.

translations.EN: Hoping the bad weather passes over us without trouble. Stay dry out there.
translations.TL: Sana lumampas ang masamang panahon nang walang gulo. Manatiling tuyo sa labas.

translations.EN: Weather's rough, but we'll weather any storm together, my friend.
translations.TL: Mabigat ang panahon, pero kakayanin natin anumang bagyo, kaibigan.

translations.EN: If it starts pouring, come share some shelter with us.
translations.TL: Kapag nagsimulang bumuhos ang ulan, sumilong ka kasama namin.

translations.EN: Just keeping an eye on the sky so none of our people get caught in the wet.
translations.TL: Binabantayan ang langit para walang mabasa sa mga kasamahan natin.

translations.EN: Gloomy day outside, but good company makes all the difference.
translations.TL: Madilim ang araw sa labas, pero iba talaga kapag may magandang kasama.
